question: Which chapter concludes the section on eight-level arrangement in this text?
premises: The text is the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa
A chapter on eight-level arrangement is named
inference: This is the thirty-fourth chapter on the arrangement of eight levels in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, on the arrangement of eight levels, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
